paragraphs.text:
You  turn  in  for  the  night,  your  thoughts  racing  with  the 
discovery of a new species. Perhaps you should have taken your 
guide’s distress more seriously. In the morning Charlie and the 
small cadaver are gone—and with them the canoe. She has, 
however, left your group its share of the weapons and supplies.

Record the keyword BAREFOOT. To continue your explorations 
without a canoe or guide, go to 604. To follow the river bank back 
down to the West Branch and civilization, go to 158.
